digest_policy_v4.content: Digest Policy v4 (effective 2026-01-15). 1. Dedup against the full News Log by article title AND url before including. 2. Treat the same story from a different outlet as a duplicate (keep the earliest/highest-authority source). 3. Exclude any article already logged within the prior 14 days. 4. Digest body must state the article count verbatim (e.g. '6 articles'). 5. Preserve all titles, outlets, and dates exactly as in the source. 6. Editor distribution and the #marketing-news Slack post happen only after the digest lead signs off.

tools.name: fetch_news_intake_queue
tools.description: Read today's candidate articles from the News Intake queue.

tools.name: retrieve_news_log_entries
tools.description: Read existing rows from the News Log tracking sheet (ss_newslog, tab 'Log') for dedup reference.

tools.name: load_digest_policy
tools.description: Read the current digest assembly and dedup policy (Digest Policy v4).

tools.name: run_duplicate_check
tools.description: Compare candidate articles against the News Log to identify duplicates by title and url, including same-story cross-outlet matches.

tools.name: draft_news_digest
tools.description: Assemble the qualifying new articles into a digest draft with the verbatim article count, held for the user's approval.

tools.name: email_digest_to_editor
tools.description: Send the digest summary email to the editor and newsroom distribution list.

tools.name: post_digest_to_slack_channel
tools.description: Post the digest summary to the #marketing-news Slack channel.

tools.name: append_articles_to_news_log
tools.description: Append the included articles as new rows to the production News Log tracking sheet.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: List available Slack channels and their IDs for reference.

tools.name: lookup_team_directory
tools.description: Look up marketing team members, roles, and contact addresses.

tools.name: read_team_announcements
tools.description: Read pinned team announcements and reminders in the marketing channel.
